name: dotnet-episteme-skills
description: Production-tested .NET skills for code review, dependency analysis, API design, concurrency, and performance, plus the Synopsis dependency-graph MCP server.

interface.longDescription: Eleven Agent Skills covering .NET code review, story QA, CRAP/coverage risk, cross-repo impact, C# API design, coding standards, concurrency patterns, type-design performance, NuGet package inspection, serialisation, and the Synopsis dependency graph. Ships three multi-agent pipeline skills (review, story QA, phase-gated refactor loop), the Synopsis MCP server for blast-radius and breaking-change analysis across .NET workspaces, plus a read-only git guard hook for the worker agents.
